title: fix(app-shell,data-objectstack): object editors edit the authored document, not the translated served read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuB3NjhvGkSE33ojXLbCGGEo)_

Fixes #29793

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 数据柱和 Setup 的对象编辑器，编辑缓冲改取 `/layers` 里作者自己的那一层：有草稿时取存储的草稿行（`draft`），没有草稿时取 `overlay ?? code`。`?state=draft` 和 `effective` 只再用于显示与判定。
- 为什么改：中文控制台下 `?state=draft` 端出的是译文，并且带着平台注入列（owner_id、queue、审计和组织列）。编辑器拿它当缓冲，改一个字段一保存，就把「工单 / 标题 / 严重程度」存成了作者标签，还把 8 个平台列当成作者字段 PUT 回去（实测：11 个字段的 PUT 体，Setup 还弹出 4 条 translated-label-echo 建议）。
- 风险与回滚：只动对象类型的编辑缓冲；其他类型和所有显示读法不变。可见变化有三条：编辑器里显示作者原文（英文源标签，字段面板已有提示「在 zh-CN 中显示为…」）；注入列不再作为可编辑字段卡出现；其他包 extension 折进来的字段不进有存储行的对象的缓冲。草稿在而 `/layers` 没给 `draft` 键时，沿用现有「草稿读不了」拒绝，不发 PUT。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/authoredObjectBuffer.ts`（唯一读法）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的对象加载与 `fieldCount` / `gridColumnsComputed`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` 的五处装缓冲。
- 两分钟验证：中文控制台打开 Studio → 数据 → 任一有中文翻译的定制对象 → 表单 → 点一个字段：显示名输入框是源文（如 Severity），改一个字后看 Network 里的 PUT `?mode=draft`：只含作者字段，标签是源文。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New `authoredObjectBuffer.ts`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`): the one reading of which document an object editor edits. `authoredObjectBuffer(layers, servedDraft)` answers the stored `draft` layer when it is a document, otherwise `unserved` when a draft body was served but the layers carry no stored copy, otherwise `overlay ?? code`. This is the contract's reading (`GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema.draft`: "A client building an edit buffer reads `draft ?? overlay ?? code`"). The served draft body only answers *whether* a draft is pending; its content is never the buffer. `authoredPublishedObject` is the `overlay ?? code` half for discard and reset. `servedOnlyFields` names the served object's fields that no authored layer declares, for display only.
- **Studio Data pillar** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`): the object load always reads `/layers` beside `?state=draft`. The objectui#12508 draft-first branch and its `publishedObjectNamesRef` are gone, because the buffer now needs the `draft` layer for a draft-only object too, and the server answers `/layers` for it. `setObjDraft` takes the authored buffer. `baseline`, `publishedFieldNames`, `publishedFormFields`, `hasBaseline` and the verdict stay on `effective` / the served draft, as before. The header's system-field count and the records grid's columns add the served-only fields back, so the header still reads the platform's columns as system fields and the grid still shows the served `owner_id` column.
- **Setup's object editor** (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `type === 'object'` only): load, save refresh, reset, publish refresh and discard all install the authored buffer. The save refresh no longer skips `/layers` for an object through `holdsNoLayer`, because the stored draft the save just wrote is the next buffer. Every other type is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`**: `MetadataClient.layered()` rebuilt its result field by field and dropped `draft`. It now forwards the key on both branches, only when the server sent it (absent = not served, `null` = no draft). `MetadataLayered` gains optional `draft?: T | null`, hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)` per the claim amendment.
- One changeset: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack`.

## Tests

New pins:
- `DataPillar.authoredBuffer-29793.test.tsx` (4 cases), over a zh-CN server double shaped as measured live (`?state=draft` translated and governed with five injected columns; `/layers` serving `draft` / `overlay` as stored and `effective` governed). With a pending draft, editing one field label in the Form inspector PUTs `{label: 'Ticket', pluralLabel: 'Tickets', fields: {title, severity}}` in source labels, with no injected key, and the draft's own `description` rides along. With no draft, the buffer is `overlay`. The header reads `2 个字段 (另有 5 个系统字段)` and the grid columns are `['owner_id', 'title', 'severity']`. A served draft with no `draft` key on the layers shows the existing `engine.studio.refusal.draftUnreadable` text and sends nothing past the autosave debounce.
- `ResourceEditPage.authoredObjectBuffer-29793.test.tsx` (3 cases), same double, the canvas stubbed to print the buffer and patch one field. With a pending draft, the buffer is the stored draft exactly; the PUT, the post-save refresh and the post-publish refresh are all authored. With no draft, the buffer is `overlay`. In the missing-key leg, the refusal is shown, no buffer is installed and no save is sent.
- `metadata-client.layeredDraft-29793.test.ts` (7 cases): `draft` is forwarded as stored, `null` as `null`, and absent stays absent, on both the conforming and the degraded branch.

Moved pins: these test doubles' `layered` now also serves the stored draft as `draft`, because without it the buffer is correctly `unserved`:
- `DataPillar.hiddenSystemFields-11780`
- `DataPillar.copilotDraftMarks-12725`
- `DataPillar.draftOnlyNoLayers-12508`: the `/layers` double now answers 200 for a draft-only name, as the server does for an admitted caller. Test 1 now expects one 200 read and is retitled "logs no failed read".
- `DataPillar.formDraftPreview-12515`
- `DataPillar.railSwitchFlush-27511`
- `DataPillar.validationVerdictHold-27644`
- `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773`
- `StudioDesignSurface.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765`

`ResourceEditPage.inspectorReadOnlyReason-29079`'s writable-object case serves the object as `overlay` instead of only as `effective`.

Ablation (each on the committed fix, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards):

| Mutation | Result |
|:---|:---|
| `authoredObjectBuffer`: `stored = servedDraft ?? …` (the served draft is the buffer again) | 5 failed / 7 (both files: every pending-draft and missing-key case) |
| Studio call site: `setObjDraft(draftBody ?? baseline)` | 3 failed / 4 in the Studio file; Setup file green |
| Setup load call site: `authored = null` (the old `draftReal ?? baseline`) | 3 failed / 3 in the Setup file; Studio file green |

Also moved: `StudioItemHeader.statusPlace-12524`'s double serves the same `draft` layer.

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- New and moved pins plus every file under `views/studio-design` and `views/metadata-admin` named `DataPillar*`, `StudioDesignSurface*`, `ResourceEditPage*`, on `d92d86b1`: `Test Files 211 passed (211)`, `Tests 1301 passed (1301)`.
- On `d74b74f6` (after merging `origin/main`), `vitest run` over `app-shell/src/views/{studio-design,metadata-admin,item-tools}`, `app-shell/src/{preview,console/__tests__,hooks/__tests__,providers/__tests__}`, `plugin-form` (incl. `affordanceGrantMap-12082`), `data-objectstack` and `apps/console/src/__tests__`: `Test Files 1 failed | 1711 passed (1712)`, `Tests 1 failed | 16954 passed | 2 skipped (16957)`. The one failure was `StudioItemHeader.statusPlace-12524` (its double did not serve the `draft` layer), fixed in `106ada2c` and re-run: `4 passed (4)`.
- The other 17 test files that name `DataPillar` / `ResourceEditPage` / `StudioDesignSurface` outside those directories (StudioRoute, AppHeader, AiChatPage, census files): `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 199 passed (199)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: both exit 0. `MetadataLayered` has no consumer outside these two packages.

Declared narrowing: the rest of app-shell's suite is left to CI's `Test UI`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Editable rows that leave the edit surface.** The platform's injected columns are no longer editable field cards. Live, on the showcase object, they were `owner_id` (Studio Form designer, shown as 负责人 with a lookup input) and, on the Setup canvas, all eight: `organization_id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id` and `queue` (plus the hidden `__search`). They are still served, still counted as system fields in the Studio header, and `owner_id` is still a records-grid column. Before, the Studio header counted `owner_id` as an own field ("3 个字段 (另有 8 个系统字段)"); after, it reads "2 个字段 (另有 9 个系统字段)".
- **Author source text in a Chinese console.** The editor shows and saves what the author typed (`Ticket`, `Title`, `Severity`). The field inspector's existing hint says how zh-CN readers see it ("在 zh-CN 中显示为'严重程度'：应用的翻译包覆盖了此显示名"). The Studio form canvas cards keep their served display labels.
- **Extension fields.** `overlay` and the stored `draft` do not fold other packages' extension fields, so for an object with a stored row those fields no longer enter the buffer, and so are no longer baked into the author's row on save. For a code-only object (no overlay, no draft) the buffer is `/layers`' `code`, which is folded as `effective` was, so that case is unchanged.
- **Missing-key leg.** A pending draft that `/layers` does not carry (served `?state=draft` body, no `draft` key) installs no buffer, shows the existing `engine.studio.refusal.draftUnreadable` text and sends nothing. No new string was added. Live, the admin caller is admitted (`mayReadPendingDrafts`) and gets the key, `null` with no draft.
- **Not changed here.** The plugin-designer `MetadataObjectsPage` / `MetadataFieldsPage` also seed their edit base from the served object (`client.list` / `client.get`) and save it live. They have no mount in this repo (exported from the package entry only), so they are left out to keep this card tight and are reported on the card as an out-of-scope finding. The same served-document-as-buffer class exists for the other translatable types in `ResourceEditPage` (view, app, dashboard); per the seat's ruling only `object` changes here.
- The PR carries no assignee or reviewer: the seat sets them at hand-over. The branch is the card thread's harness branch (`claude/project-thread-18upfc`, claim amendment 6674080630).

## Verification

Live, app-showcase (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) with Console via Vite, headless Chromium at 1440 px, `Accept-Language: zh-CN`, admin. Fixture: `showcase_custom_ticket` in `com.example.showcase.custom` (label `Ticket`, fields `title` / `severity`), published zh-CN translation (工单 / 标题 / 严重程度). The draft was reset to the stored row before the after leg.

| | Studio: label input on open | Studio: PUT `?mode=draft` after one edit | Setup: autosave PUT `?mode=draft` |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| before (`origin/main` e8dc4833) | `严重程度` | label `工单`, 11 fields in Chinese incl. `owner_id=负责人`, `queue=队列` | label `工单`, 11 fields, 4 `translated-label-echo` advisories |
| after | `Severity` | label `Ticket`, 2 fields `title=Title`, `severity=级别` | label `Ticket`, 2 fields `title=Title`, `severity=级别` |

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `da74dac5`: 35 families, all `exit 0` (incl. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`). `--ran` with exit codes: "35 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 35 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". The later commits add test files only, and the derived set at `106ada2c` is byte-identical. `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
</details>
